Description.value: Controller: direct toolbelt access with LB/RB chords (LB tap = 1, LB + A/X/Y/B = 2-5, LB + RB = 6, RB + A/X/Y/B = 7-10, RB tap = 11), an 11th toolbelt slot, animated button hints on the slots and a short haptic pulse. Menus, vehicles and radials stay vanilla. Works with and without the mod on the other side.
